text:
Emma (Finance): Quick flag — Nimbus Health is disputing the Mar invoice INV-2026-0316-9876. They say a large embeddings export charged twice (duplicate job). Ticket SUP-4921. Asking for a goodwill refund + promo credit. @Luca can we approve? Need manual adjustment if refund goes ahead.

Sam (Support): Adding context — customer ran an export on 2026-03-15, UI glitch retried the job and both runs completed. Job ids: job_6632 and job_6632_dup. CC @Ben for usage verification.

Ben (Engineering): Ran a quick check: `SELECT job_id, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM usage WHERE job_id IN ('job_6632','job_6632_dup') GROUP BY job_id;`
Results: job_6632 = 1,200,000 tokens, job_6632_dup = 1,190,400 tokens. Confirmed duplicate billing.

Billing Bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-2026-0316-9876 total $12,340.00. Line item: embeddings-export $6,170.00 appears twice. Potential adjustment code: ADJ-8421.

Luca (Sales): Nimbus is on an annual commit (net ~ $120k ARR). Recommendation: refund duplicate line item (~$6,170) as goodwill + apply $500 promo for next invoice. I support refund + promo; finance sign-off needed for the manual adj.

Emma (Finance): I can approve the manual adjustment for $6,170 refund against INV-2026-0316-9876. For the promo credit, please send a one-line memo: "promotional credit for job duplication - $500". @Ben can you create the adjustment PR using ADJ-8421 and mark it non-recurring?

Ben (Engineering): Will create the billing adjustment PR and attach logs. API snippet I'll call: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments { "invoice": "INV-2026-0316-9876", "amount": -6170, "reason": "duplicate job refund", "code": "ADJ-8421" }`. I will also tag the run ids in the PR.

Sam (Support): Told the customer: "We'll process the refund within 5-7 business days and apply a $500 promo credit to your next invoice." Customer replied with :thumbsup:. Updating SUP-4921 with the adjustment reference.

Luca (Sales): Sounds good — I’ll follow up on carrier email and make sure account team notes the promo in CRM.

Emma (Finance): Done — manual adjustment ADJ-8421 created and queued, promo code PROMO-NIMBUS-500 generated. Will close once ledger posts. :white_check_mark:

Billing Bot: Adjustment ADJ-8421 posted to ledger on 2026-03-18. Invoice balance updated; promo PROMO-NIMBUS-500 applied to account. Customer email queued.
